verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no first-party natural-language command interface or built-in assistant for operating 1Password itself. The Environments MCP Server lets external agents such as Claude Code manage Environments, but that belongs to the separate MCP-server story; the natural language comes from a third-party client, not from 1Password. The AI-readable docs and docs MCP only let users ask questions about the developer tools, not run commands in the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
